name: SAP FICO
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Financial Accounting (C_S4FCF)
SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA for Management Accounting (C_S4FCC)
SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Finance

beginner.summary: For finance professionals and new consultants with no SAP experience. Covers the finance organisation in SAP, general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, asset accounting, bank and tax postings, controlling basics with cost centres and internal orders, period-end closing and finance reporting in S/4HANA.
prerequisites: Understands basic accounting: debits, credits, ledgers and financial statements
Comfortable with business software and spreadsheets
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Post and display finance documents in S/4HANA
Run payables, receivables, asset and bank processes
Track costs with cost centres and internal orders
Perform basic month-end closing and finance reporting

days.topic: SAP Finance Overview and System Navigation
subtopics: Finance in S/4HANA: FI and CO
The Universal Journal in plain terms
Integration with purchasing, sales and production
Fiori finance apps and SAP GUI transactions
Logging on and personalising the launchpad
Course map and the model company
Ground rules for the training system
days.lab_task: Log on, find the main finance apps, display a journal entry created by a sales invoice and trace it back to the sales document and forward to the customer account.
days.deliverable: Screenshots of the document trail and a list of ten finance apps and their uses
checks: Display the journal entry in the Manage Journal Entries app
Line items with accounts and amounts shown
Navigate to the source sales document

days.topic: Finance Organisation: Company Code, Chart of Accounts and Fiscal Year
subtopics: Chart of accounts: operating, group and country
days.lab_task: Document the finance organisation of the model company: company codes, currencies, chart of accounts, fiscal year and posting period variants and the controlling area assignment.
days.deliverable: Finance organisation sheet with values from the system
checks: Find the fiscal year variant of company code 1010
Explain why company codes share a chart of accounts

days.topic: General Ledger Accounts and Master Data
subtopics: Balance sheet and profit and loss accounts
Open item management and line item display
tools: Manage G/L Account Master Data app
days.lab_task: Create a balance sheet account with open item management, an expense account with a primary cost element type and a reconciliation account, and block one for posting.
days.deliverable: Three account records and a blocked posting attempt
checks: Try to post directly to the reconciliation account

days.topic: Posting General Ledger Journal Entries
days.lab_task: Post an accrual, park and then post a journal entry, set up a monthly recurring rent entry and reverse a wrong posting with a reversal reason.
days.deliverable: Document numbers and screenshots for each posting
checks: Run the recurring entry for the next period

days.topic: Accounts Payable: Supplier Master and Invoices
subtopics: Company code data: reconciliation account and payment terms
Supplier invoices without a purchase order
days.lab_task: Create a supplier with payment terms, post three invoices and a credit memo, post a down payment request and payment, and display the open items.
days.deliverable: Supplier record, documents and open item list
checks: Explain why the reconciliation account is updated automatically

days.topic: Accounts Payable: Payments and the Payment Run
days.lab_task: Run the automatic payment program for the suppliers, exclude one blocked invoice, check the proposal, run the payment and confirm open items are cleared.
days.deliverable: Proposal, payment run log and cleared items

days.topic: Accounts Receivable: Customer Invoices and Incoming Payments
days.lab_task: Post customer invoices, record a partial payment, a residual payment and a small underpayment within tolerance, and display the customer's balance.
days.deliverable: Documents and customer line item report
checks: Invoice stays open with the payment linked

days.topic: Accounts Receivable: Dunning and Credit Control
subtopics: Credit management in S/4HANA in brief
days.lab_task: Run dunning for overdue customers, check the letters and levels, set a credit limit and show a sales order blocked by credit for a customer over the limit.
days.deliverable: Dunning run, letters, credit settings and blocked order
checks: Overdue customers receive the right level
Create a sales order over the limit

days.topic: Asset Accounting: Asset Master and Acquisitions
days.lab_task: Create assets in two classes, acquire one through a supplier invoice and one through purchasing, and review values and planned depreciation in the asset explorer.
days.deliverable: Asset records, acquisition documents and asset explorer screenshots

days.topic: Asset Accounting: Depreciation, Transfers and Retirements
days.lab_task: Run depreciation for a period, transfer an asset to another cost centre, sell an asset with a gain and scrap another, and check the postings and history sheet.
days.deliverable: Depreciation run log, transfer, retirement documents and history sheet
checks: Expense and accumulated depreciation are posted
Sell an asset above book value

days.topic: Bank Accounting and the Cash Journal
days.lab_task: Import a bank statement file, let the system clear matching payments, process unmatched lines by hand and record petty cash in the cash journal.
days.deliverable: Processed statement, cleared items and cash journal entries
checks: Agrees with the statement closing balance

days.topic: Tax Postings: GST and Indirect Tax in SAP
subtopics: GST in India: CGST, SGST and IGST
Tax on supplier and customer invoices
days.lab_task: Post intra-state and inter-state invoices with GST codes, check the tax lines, run the tax return report and post a withholding tax deduction on a supplier payment.
days.deliverable: Invoices, tax report and withholding document
checks: Pay a supplier with withholding tax
Tax amount is deducted and posted

days.topic: Controlling with Cost Centres and Cost Elements
subtopics: Cost centres and the standard hierarchy
days.lab_task: Create cost centres in the hierarchy, post expenses to them from finance, repost a wrong posting and compare plan and actual costs.
days.deliverable: Cost centre records, postings and plan/actual report
checks: Post an expense with a cost centre
Cost appears on the cost centre

days.topic: Internal Orders and Settlement
days.lab_task: Create an internal order for a marketing event with a budget, post costs until availability control warns, settle it to a cost centre and close it.
days.deliverable: Order, budget warning, settlement document and order report
checks: Warning or error from availability control
Balance is zero and the cost centre is charged

days.topic: Profit Centres and Segment Reporting
days.lab_task: Create profit centres for two business lines, assign them to cost centres and materials, post transactions and produce a profit and loss and balance sheet by profit centre.
days.deliverable: Profit centre set-up and reports
checks: Profit centre is derived from the material

days.topic: Integration of Finance with Purchasing and Sales
subtopics: Revenue and receivable postings from billing
Cost of goods sold at goods issue
days.lab_task: Follow a purchase and a sale through finance, explaining every posting, and fix a planted missing account determination that stops a goods receipt.
days.deliverable: Posting map for both processes and the fix
checks: Post the goods receipt after the fix
Revenue, tax and receivable are posted

days.topic: Period-End Closing in Finance
days.lab_task: Run a month-end close for the model company with a checklist: accruals, depreciation, settlement, foreign currency valuation and GR/IR regrouping, then close the period.
days.deliverable: Completed checklist with documents and the closed period
checks: Every task has a result and document

days.topic: Finance Reporting and Analytics
days.lab_task: Produce the monthly finance pack: financial statement, trial balance, ageing of receivables and payables and cost centre report, and reconcile the totals.
days.deliverable: Finance pack and reconciliation sheet
checks: Reconcile the trial balance to the financial statement
Reconcile receivables ageing to the G/L balance
Ageing total equals the receivables reconciliation account balance
Drill from a statement line to documents

days.topic: Finance Roles, Controls and Audit Support
days.lab_task: Review finance roles for a segregation of duties conflict between supplier creation and payment, show the change log of a supplier bank account and list the controls that prevent fraud.
days.deliverable: Conflict analysis, change log and control list
checks: Display the supplier bank change log
Old and new values with user and time
Each control prevents or detects a named risk

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: A Month of Finance for the Model Company
days.lab_task: Run a full month for the model company: supplier and customer invoices, payments, a payment run, an asset purchase and depreciation, cost centre postings, bank reconciliation and closing, then present the finance pack.
days.deliverable: Document list, finance pack and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Explain one variance on a cost centre
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one month

intermediate.summary: For finance users and junior consultants who know SAP postings. Covers configuration of the finance organisation, general ledger, payables, receivables, assets, banks and tax, controlling configuration with product costing and margin analysis, integration settings and closing processes in S/4HANA.
prerequisites: Can post and report finance documents in S/4HANA
Knows payables, receivables, assets and cost centres as a user
Understands accounting standards at a basic level
outcomes: Configure the finance organisation and core finance processes
Configure controlling, product costing and margin analysis
Set up integration between finance and logistics
Design and run efficient closing processes

days.topic: Configuring the Finance Organisation
subtopics: Defining company codes and assigning to company
Fiscal year and posting period variants
Chart of accounts and account groups
days.lab_task: Configure a new company code by copying, set its fiscal year and posting period variants, field status variant, tolerance groups and number ranges, and post a test document.
days.deliverable: Configuration record and test posting
checks: Post a test document in the new company code
Posting works with the new number range
Every setting and value is listed

days.topic: Ledgers, Accounting Principles and Currencies in S/4HANA
days.lab_task: Configure a non-leading ledger for local GAAP, post an adjustment only to it, compare reports for both ledgers and check amounts in three currency types.
days.deliverable: Ledger configuration, posting and comparison
checks: Post to the non-leading ledger only
Display the document in three currencies
Amounts converted with the right rates

days.topic: Document Splitting and Segment Balancing
days.lab_task: Configure document splitting by profit centre and segment, post invoices with several profit centres and payments, and show balanced segments in the documents.
days.deliverable: Splitting configuration and split documents
checks: Receivable is split by profit centre
Post a document missing the characteristic
Error or default is applied as configured

days.topic: Configuring Accounts Payable and the Payment Program
subtopics: Payment program configuration: company codes, methods, banks
days.lab_task: Configure a bank transfer payment method with bank determination for two house banks and a payment medium format, then run payments and show the bank chosen for each.
days.deliverable: Payment configuration and payment run results
checks: Bank chosen according to ranking and amounts

days.topic: Configuring Accounts Receivable, Dunning and Credit Management
subtopics: Credit management: segments, rules and scoring
days.lab_task: Configure a dunning procedure with three levels and charges, reason codes for short payments and credit rules with automatic scoring, then test them on customers.
days.deliverable: Configuration and test results
checks: Difference posted to the account for that reason
Levels and charges match the configuration
Credit score and limit calculated by the rule

days.topic: Configuring Asset Accounting
days.lab_task: Configure an asset class with account determination and a depreciation key for straight-line and declining balance methods, transfer legacy assets and check depreciation.
days.deliverable: Configuration, legacy transfer and depreciation check
checks: Create an asset in the new class
Transfer a legacy asset with accumulated depreciation

days.topic: Banking Configuration and Electronic Bank Statements
days.lab_task: Configure posting rules and search strings so that 90 percent of a provided bank statement clears automatically, and reprocess the rest.
days.deliverable: Configuration and match rate report
checks: At least 90 percent of lines clear automatically
Use a search string for a reference in the note

days.topic: Tax Configuration and GST Compliance
subtopics: E-invoicing and e-way bills in brief
days.lab_task: Configure GST tax codes for intra- and inter-state purchases and sales and a withholding tax type, post test documents and generate a compliance report in DRC.
days.deliverable: Tax configuration, test postings and DRC report
checks: Post a purchase with the new code
CGST and SGST lines posted to the right accounts

days.topic: Controlling Configuration: Controlling Area and Cost Centre Accounting
days.lab_task: Configure assessment and distribution cycles using statistical key figures, plan activity prices for a production cost centre and run the cycles.
days.deliverable: Cycle configuration, plan and results
checks: Change a key figure and rerun

days.topic: Product Costing: Cost Estimates and Standard Prices
days.lab_task: Create a cost estimate for a finished product with materials, activities and overheads, analyse the cost components, and mark and release the standard price.
days.deliverable: Cost estimate, component report and released price
checks: Material, labour and overhead components shown
Change a component price and recost

days.topic: Cost Object Controlling: Production Order Costs and Variances
days.lab_task: Process two production orders with planned differences, calculate work in process for one and variances for the other, settle both and explain the variance categories.
days.deliverable: Order cost reports, WIP and variance results and settlement
checks: Calculate WIP for the open order
WIP posted to the balance sheet

days.topic: Margin Analysis (CO-PA) in S/4HANA
subtopics: Revenue and costs by market segment
days.lab_task: Configure characteristics for region and customer group, derive them on sales, split cost of goods sold into components and report contribution margin by segment.
days.deliverable: Configuration and margin report
checks: Display cost of goods sold split

days.topic: Integration Settings: Automatic Account Determination
subtopics: Payroll and other posting interfaces in brief
days.lab_task: Set up account determination for a new valuation class and a new customer account group, simulate postings and fix two planted errors.
days.deliverable: Configuration, simulation results and fixes
checks: Post a goods receipt for the new class
Bill a customer in the new group
Postings work and the cause is documented

days.topic: Material Ledger and Actual Costing
days.lab_task: Run an actual costing cycle for a period with purchase price differences, review the periodic unit price in CKM3 and revalue inventory.
days.deliverable: Costing run log, CKM3 analysis and revaluation document

days.topic: Foreign Currency Valuation and Intercompany Processes
days.lab_task: Configure a valuation method, revalue open foreign currency items at month-end, post an intercompany expense allocation and reconcile intercompany balances.
days.deliverable: Configuration, valuation documents and reconciliation report
checks: Gains and losses posted per item
Both company codes updated with clearing entries

days.topic: Closing Processes: Advanced Financial Closing
days.lab_task: Build a closing template for two company codes with dependencies and automated jobs, run a month-end close, monitor progress and measure close time.
days.deliverable: Closing template, run results and close time
checks: Tasks run in the right order
Dependent tasks wait and an alert is raised
Recorded and compared with the manual close

days.topic: Finance Data Migration
days.lab_task: Migrate opening balances, open payables and receivables and fixed assets from templates, reconcile every balance and prepare the sign-off sheet.
days.deliverable: Templates, migration logs and signed reconciliation
checks: Equal to the source trial balance
Totals per supplier and customer match

days.topic: Fiori Apps for Finance Users and Consultants
days.lab_task: Set up a finance launchpad for an accounts payable clerk and a controller with the right apps and KPIs, and show each completing a daily task only in Fiori.
days.deliverable: Launchpad set-up and task walkthroughs
checks: Clerk processes an invoice in Fiori
Controller reviews a cost centre KPI
KPI tile shows actual against plan
Find each app in the apps library

days.topic: Testing and Supporting Finance Processes
days.lab_task: Write and run tests for procure to pay and order to cash finance postings, fix five common user support issues and write a user guide for the payment run.
days.deliverable: Test results, support fixes and user guide
checks: Every posting matches the expected accounts
At least four fixed with the cause explained
A new user can run the payment program from it

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Finance Configuration for a New Company Code
days.lab_task: Configure finance and controlling for a new company code with ledgers, payments, dunning, assets, banks, tax, cost centres, product costing and margin analysis, migrate opening balances and run a first close, then present it.
days.deliverable: Configuration document, test results, migration reconciliation and a 15-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one configuration
Prove it with a test close

advanced.summary: For senior finance consultants, solution architects and finance transformation leads. Covers Universal Journal design, parallel accounting, group reporting, central finance, treasury and cash management, revenue and lease accounting, advanced controlling, finance in conversions, analytics and AI in finance, and finance transformation leadership.
prerequisites: Has configured SAP finance and controlling in a project
Understands IFRS and local accounting requirements
outcomes: Design finance architectures on the Universal Journal
Lead group reporting, central finance and treasury solutions
Implement revenue, lease and advanced controlling requirements
Lead finance transformation and conversion workstreams

days.topic: Universal Journal Design and Finance Architecture
days.lab_task: Design the Universal Journal for a group with three accounting principles and four currencies, extend the coding block with one field and record the main decisions.
days.deliverable: Finance architecture document, coding block extension and decision records
checks: Post with the new coding block field

days.topic: Parallel Accounting: IFRS, Local GAAP and Tax Ledgers
days.lab_task: Implement IFRS and local GAAP ledgers with different depreciation and provisions, run a close for both and reconcile the differences between them.
days.deliverable: Configuration, closing results and reconciliation
checks: Different amounts per ledger as designed
Post a provision to IFRS only

days.topic: Group Reporting and Consolidation
tools: SAP S/4HANA Finance for group reporting
days.lab_task: Consolidate three companies with currency translation, intercompany elimination and investment consolidation, and produce group statements that balance.
days.deliverable: Consolidation set-up, task log and group statements

days.topic: Central Finance Design and Implementation
days.lab_task: Configure mapping for accounts, cost centres and profit centres from two source systems, run an initial load, handle replication errors and reconcile.
days.deliverable: Mapping configuration, load reports and reconciliation
checks: Replicate a posting from a source system

days.topic: Treasury and Cash Management
subtopics: Financial transactions: deposits, loans, FX deals
days.lab_task: Build a 13-week liquidity forecast, record an FX forward and a term deposit in treasury, settle them and show their effect on the cash position.
days.deliverable: Forecast, treasury deals and cash position report

days.topic: Revenue Accounting and IFRS 15
days.lab_task: Account for a bundle contract with hardware and a two-year service, allocate the price, recognise revenue over time and handle a contract change.
days.deliverable: Contract set-up, revenue schedule and change handling
checks: Run revenue recognition for a period

days.topic: Lease Accounting and IFRS 16
tools: SAP Real Estate Management / Flexible Real Estate
days.lab_task: Set up an office lease, create the right-of-use asset and liability, run periodic postings, remeasure after a rent change and produce lease disclosures.
days.deliverable: Lease contract, postings, remeasurement and disclosure report
checks: Right-of-use asset and liability match a spreadsheet

days.topic: Advanced Controlling: Activity-Based Costing and Overhead Management
subtopics: Cost centre planning with SAP Analytics Cloud
days.lab_task: Implement activity-based costing for order handling, allocate overheads with universal allocation and compare product margins with traditional costing.
days.deliverable: Configuration, allocation results and margin comparison

days.topic: Transfer Pricing and Profit Centre Valuation
days.lab_task: Configure group and profit centre valuation for intercompany sales with transfer prices, show margins in each view and eliminate intercompany profit in consolidation.
days.deliverable: Configuration, valuation reports and elimination results
checks: Legal and group views show different margins

days.topic: Finance in S/4HANA Conversion Projects
subtopics: Migration of finance data during conversion
days.lab_task: Plan the finance workstream of a conversion: pre-checks, reconciliations before and after, finance migration steps and cutover tasks, and resolve three planted pre-check findings.
days.deliverable: Finance conversion plan, resolved findings and reconciliation checklist
checks: Each closed with the fix recorded

days.topic: Financial Planning and Analysis with SAP Analytics Cloud
days.lab_task: Build a driver-based cost centre and revenue plan in SAP Analytics Cloud from S/4HANA actuals, create a forecast version and write the plan back to S/4HANA.
days.deliverable: Planning model, forecast and write-back evidence
objectives: Plan finance in SAP Analytics Cloud

days.topic: Finance Analytics and Embedded Reporting at Scale
days.lab_task: Rationalise 40 legacy finance reports into a smaller set of embedded and Datasphere-based reports, build three key reports and a CFO dashboard.
days.deliverable: Report mapping, three reports and dashboard
checks: Each mapped to a new report or retired with a reason

days.topic: Automation and AI in Finance
days.lab_task: Measure cash application match rates with and without machine learning, automate an invoice approval flow and design controls for AI-proposed postings.
days.deliverable: Match rate comparison, automated flow and control design
checks: Each AI decision has a review rule

days.topic: Finance Controls, GRC and Audit at Scale
subtopics: Segregation of duties in finance at scale
Audit trails in the Universal Journal
days.lab_task: Design a finance control matrix with automated controls, set up continuous monitoring for two controls and prepare an audit evidence pack.
days.deliverable: Control matrix, monitoring set-up and evidence pack
checks: Each risk has a control and owner

days.topic: Tax and Statutory Compliance at Scale
subtopics: Document and Reporting Compliance in depth
days.lab_task: Plan e-invoicing and statutory reporting for India and two European countries in DRC, configure one country end to end and test submission and error handling.
days.deliverable: Compliance plan, configuration and submission test results
checks: Rejection is shown with the reason

days.topic: Shared Services and Finance Operations Design
subtopics: Shared service processes: P2P, O2C, R2R
days.lab_task: Design a finance shared service centre for accounts payable and receivable, define service levels and metrics, and model staffing for the transaction volumes.
days.deliverable: Service design, service level agreements and staffing model
checks: Tied to cost and quality goals

days.topic: Finance Transformation Roadmaps and Business Cases
subtopics: Benefits: faster close, lower cost, better insight
days.lab_task: Build a finance transformation roadmap and business case for a provided company with capability gaps, benefits, phases and KPIs, and present it to a mock CFO.
days.deliverable: Capability map, business case, roadmap and presentation

days.topic: Troubleshooting Finance Postings and Reconciliation Differences
days.lab_task: Resolve four injected problems (a sub-ledger difference, wrong account determination, a splitting error and a failed valuation), post corrections and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, corrections and runbooks
checks: Write a runbook for valuation failures

days.topic: Finance Solution Architecture Reviews
days.lab_task: Review two proposed finance designs from a case study, find risks against accounting policy and scale, write decision records and defend a recommendation to a mock design authority.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records and presentation
checks: List the risks in each design

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Group Finance Transformation Blueprint
days.lab_task: Produce a group finance blueprint with ledger and currency design, consolidation, central finance, treasury, IFRS 15 and 16, controlling and planning, controls and automation, prototype two scenarios and present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Blueprint, two prototypes, business case and a 20-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one blueprint
